name: RC-B10-0146/2025/REV1 – § 74 – Am 19
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the white paper on the future of European defence
part_text: 74.Reiterates, in line with the Commission’s ‘ReArm Europe’ plan, its call for the European Investment Bank (EIB) and other international financial institutions and private banks in Europe to invest more actively in the European defence industry; calls, in particular, for an urgent revision of the EIB’s lending policy and immediate flexibility to remove current restrictions on financing defence innovation,*and for the possibility of issuing earmarked debt for funding security and defence projects that focus on innovation to be investigated, while safeguarding its operations and financing capacity;
